FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS carcinogenic_count

    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE m.label LIKE '%carcinogen%' AND b.bond_type = 'single'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) carcinogenic_molecules;

WITH first_loan_account AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance AS start_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan_account)
      AND t.date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance AS end_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan_account)
      AND t.date <= '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    (b_end.end_balance - b_start.start_balance) * 100.0 / b_start.start_balance AS increase_rate_percent
FROM balance_start b_start
JOIN balance_end b_end ON b_start.account_id = b_end.account_id;

SELECT AVG(carcinogenic_count) AS avg_carcinogenic_single_bonded
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id) AS carcinogenic_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE m.label = 'carcinogenic' AND b.bond_type = 'single'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) carcinogenic_molecules;
